requirements.evidence: Prefix resolution and range fallback are correct (app/Models/Queue.php:33-61), key/value/uniqueness validation is thorough (app/Models/Queue.php:69-120), empty maps are normalized to NULL on save (app/Models/Queue.php:126-134), IssueTicket reads now() once for code day/issued_at/issue_date (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:44-58), nextCode filters by prefix and issue_date and skips malformed/legacy codes (app/Models/Ticket.php:41-60), the factory aligns issue_date to issued_at and allocates by priority/day (database/factories/TicketFactory.php:44-101), and UpdateQueue handles null/[]/invalid (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:24-30,66-74). The one defect is the rollback: down() re-adds unique(['queue_id','code']) (database/migrations/2026_10_29_000002_add_issue_date_to_tickets_table.php:62-64), which cannot succeed once the new daily behavior has produced the same code on two days.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes stay in app/Actions, authorization still via Gate::forUser (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:22), the map is kept out of #[Fillable] (app/Models/Queue.php:11), migrations follow the generator stub with a down(), and docs are synced (CHANGELOG.md:9, docs/business-rules.md:78,83, docs/database-schema.md:101,116,156, docs/api/totem.md:260-261). Deviation: the project's test-first rule is not met for almost all new behavior, and the same map is validated twice (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:24-30 plus the model saving hook at app/Models/Queue.php:123-143).

security.evidence: No Livewire surface is touched; the map remains non-mass-assignable (app/Models/Queue.php:11) and is only writable through UpdateQueue, which still authorizes first (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:22); all map input is validated server-side (app/Models/Queue.php:80-119) and surfaced as a field-scoped ValidationException (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:28,74); no new unescaped output or client-trusted identifiers.

tests.evidence: Only tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php is changed: existing A-codes are renamed to N-codes and two nextCode cases are added (tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php:88-107 for malformed skip and legacy A). There is no test for the daily restart, independent per-prefix sequences, custom-map issuance, Queue::validatePrefixMap, UpdateQueue's null/[]/invalid paths, or the factory's issue_date/priority allocation.

simplicity.evidence: DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP (app/Models/Queue.php:24-28) is never referenced; defaultPrefixFor() (app/Models/Queue.php:33-43) and the uniqueness loop (app/Models/Queue.php:111-115) hardcode the same N/P/E and [0,10,20] values. Validation is duplicated between the action (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:24-30) and the saving hook (app/Models/Queue.php:123-143), and the factory's queue resolution grew several overlapping branches (database/factories/TicketFactory.php:61-101).

readability.evidence: Public methods are documented (app/Models/Ticket.php:29-40,65-67; app/Models/Queue.php:110-122) and named clearly, but validatePrefixMap's two-pass normalize-then-uniqueness loop (app/Models/Queue.php:80-119) and the factory's five-way queue/prefix resolution (database/factories/TicketFactory.php:61-101) take effort to follow; the nextCode PHPDoc declares a non-nullable $issueDate (app/Models/Ticket.php:39) although the parameter defaults to null (app/Models/Ticket.php:41).

scope.evidence: Every edit serves the ticket-code feature: model/action/factory/migration changes, the adapted tests, and doc updates. The extra docs/api/totem.md edit (docs/api/totem.md:260-261) is doc-freshness for the same code contract, not unrelated work.

issues.explanation: down() re-adds the old unique(['queue_id','code']) index while the daily behavior allows the same code on different issue_dates, so rolling back after any day boundary fails on a duplicate entry and leaves the migration half-applied.

The only added coverage is two nextCode edge cases; the core new behavior (daily restart, independent N/P/E sequences, custom priority_prefix_map, Queue validation, UpdateQueue null/[]/invalid handling, factory date/priority allocation) has no tests.
DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP is declared but never used, duplicating the mapping hardcoded in defaultPrefixFor() and in the [0, 10, 20] uniqueness loop.
The map is validated explicitly in the action and again by the model's saving hook (app/Models/Queue.php:142), making the action's second catch/refresh path redundant.

Queue/prefix resolution in afterMaking uses several overlapping branches (relationLoaded, getAttribute('queue'), queue_id being a Queue, a DB find), which is much harder to follow than the three-line original.
The PHPDoc types $issueDate as non-nullable but the signature defaults it to null, so the docblock does not describe the actual contract.

review.summary: The change implements the priority-prefixed, per-day ticket numbering largely as specified, including the queue map, one-clock issuance, factory alignment, UpdateQueue wiring and doc updates. It is not ready to merge: the migration's down() cannot roll back once daily duplicates exist, and almost all of the new behavior ships without tests, with smaller simplicity/readability debt such as the unused DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP and duplicated map validation.
